quarterly_data.signal: COMMERCIAL PIPELINE: CEO Jim Burke: 'Data center development activity remains strong, we continue to be in active negotiations with large load customers'. Stacey Doré: 'We're in active discussions in both markets across multiple sites both about our existing resources as well as new build'; customers share where they are looking to locate their data centers, and 'customers don't need perfect clarity in order to contract. You can find ways to deal with those risks through contractual provisions.' PJM (CEO): the bilateral conversation 'is something that we have real possibilities with customers. We have good sites', and 'Any bilaterals, as you know, that get done that meet the hurdles could drop the required RBP procured amount'; for the RBP itself 'there's realistically batteries, peakers, CCGTs that you could see bid into that'. Helix pipeline (Doré): 'You can think about the pipeline as really anything that's in our existing portfolio', plus inbound customer opportunities Helix brings to Vistra.

TEXAS SITING AND BATCH ZERO (CEO Jim Burke): 'there isn't a moratorium at this point in time'; the PUC and ERCOT will work through the audits, 'we think in a couple months' timeframe', and 'We don't see it impacting our projects in the timeframe that we were expecting to energize.' Local example from the two counties around a Vistra nuclear plant: 'There were eight projects being considered in that county. Per my earlier remarks, there is a reasonable chance there'll be no projects in that county', after local concern ('I might be okay with one of these, but I don't know if I'm okay with eight of these'). The CEO expects the already-studied Batch Zero baseload projects to keep moving while the to-be-studied load faces more uncertainty; Vistra's projects are 'tagged towards next year'. Stacey Doré: the PUC, ERCOT and Texas stakeholders are motivated to get the audit done 'in a way that it doesn't result in material delays for the projects there.'
quarterly_data.figure: eight projects considered in one county near a Vistra nuclear plant; possibly none
